title: Sales KPI Dashboard
description: You know BI pieces separately — now integrate them: build a dashboard over a real sales CSV with KPIs, drill-downs and a one-page written read-out for a manager.
deliverable_hint: Public repo or notebook + screenshots of the dashboard.

title: Customer Churn Exploratory Analysis
description: Apply cleaning and inference skills end-to-end: take a churn dataset, clean it, test two hypotheses statistically and present findings as if to a retention team.
deliverable_hint: Notebook with narrative + charts, runs top to bottom.

title: Personal Blog Platform
description: Wire your frontend and backend knowledge into one deployed app: React blog with Markdown posts served by your own Node/Express + SQL API.
deliverable_hint: Deployed URL + repo with README setup instructions.

title: Secure Notes API
description: Prove backend maturity: a REST API with user accounts, token auth, per-user data isolation and automated tests for the auth flows.
deliverable_hint: Repo with passing test suite + API docs.

title: Monitored Container Stack
description: Combine containers, CI and observability: ship a two-service Docker Compose app with a CI pipeline and dashboards showing request and error metrics.
deliverable_hint: Repo with Compose file, CI workflow and dashboard screenshots.

title: VPC with Terraform
description: Turn cloud theory into infrastructure: define a small network with public/private subnets, security groups and one compute instance, entirely in Terraform on a free-tier account.
deliverable_hint: Terraform repo + applied plan output (redact secrets).

title: House Price Predictor
description: Your first full modeling project: clean a housing dataset, train and compare two regressors, report honest metrics and failure cases in the README.
deliverable_hint: Notebook + README with metrics table and limitations.

title: Ship a Classifier as a Service
description: Go from notebook to product thinking: wrap a trained tree-ensemble classifier in a small API, document inputs/outputs and how you would monitor it in production.
deliverable_hint: Repo with API code + example requests.
